summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on PR #416, then merge and pull main. After merging, update project documentation on a new docs branch: prune stale deferred items, update FEATURES.md and README.md, and create a new filesystem specification doc.
summary.outcome: PR #416 review comments were resolved and merged. A docs branch PR #419 was created with updated DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, and a new docs/FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md. DEFERRED.md went through multiple audit rounds to remove already-implemented, anti-feature, or out-of-scope items.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the error tracking and remote log shipping solution — not Sentry or Datadog/Loki.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.
Desktop FUSE layer (crates/fuse/) is intentionally untested at unit level — it is plumbing between OS and Rust SDK, covered by Desktop E2E suite instead.
Vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the baseline migration 1700000000000-FullSchema.ts was written post-reset and contains no v1 fields.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable retention period remains genuinely deferred.
pin:secondaryFailed event was implemented in Phase 37 of the parallel batch upload pipeline.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection has been live since Phase 12.6.
Phase 37 was the parallel batch upload pipeline; phases tracked in .planning/phases/ with CONTEXT, PLAN, SUMMARY, RESEARCH, VALIDATION, VERIFICATION docs.
Project uses .planning/todos/pending and .planning/todos/done for task tracking; web worker encryption todo was still in pending despite Phase 37 implementing it.
Batch upload is not implemented in the Rust SDK — only in the JS SDK and web app.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw, leaking pending map entries — fixed with try/catch that deletes pending entry on error
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — fixed to clarify actual memory behavior
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural issue, deferred; requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array
Grafana Faro integration for error tracking and remote log shipping

workflow: When asked to audit a list and prune stale items, do every item systematically — not just the ones the user explicitly calls out. A shallow pass will require multiple correction rounds.
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot frequently flag the same issues independently; cross-reference before treating as separate findings.
Integration tests requiring a live backend (integration.test.ts) will fail in CI-like local runs — these are pre-existing and should be distinguished from unit test failures.
gh api graphql must be used to resolve review threads; REST API is used for posting replies (with --field not -f for integer params like in_reply_to).
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS distinction: operator config vs user-facing setting — important to distinguish when auditing deferred items.

friction: Multiple rounds needed to properly audit DEFERRED.md — assistant took a shallow pass the first time instead of verifying every item systematically.
File edit tool reformatted table widths, requiring re-read of actual file content before further edits.
Bash push failed on first attempt for docs branch, requiring a retry.
Web worker encryption todo was still in pending/ despite being implemented in Phase 37 — required manual discovery and move.
open_items: Lazy file reading within concurrency pool in useDropUpload.ts — requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array (tracked as deferred, duplicate of CodeRabbit thread 8).
User-configurable recycle bin retention period — RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is operator-only; end-user setting not yet implemented.
Batch upload not implemented in Rust SDK — only JS SDK and web app have it.
All remaining items in .planning/DEFERRED.md (Observability, Upload Pipeline, Code Quality, Security, Sharing, Desktop, Auth, Data Management, Infrastructure categories).
PR #419 (docs/update-project-documentation) still needs review and merge.
